statement: Size an outdoor virtual wind tunnel around test geometry from building heights, overriding the default dimensions if needed.
superiority: Auto-sized domain from published guidelines with blockage check and visual preview.

acceptance.tolerance: Domain extents within 2% of guideline formula; blockage < 3%

statement: Generate the OpenFOAM-style background hexahedral mesh for a case as the first meshing step.
superiority: Native background mesh builder with size preview and cell-count estimate.

acceptance.corpus: Wind tunnel domain with 0.5, 1 and 2 m cells
acceptance.tolerance: Cell sizes within 1% of request; cell count equals analytic

statement: Define the castellated, snap and layer-addition settings that conform a hex mesh to input geometry and refinement regions.
superiority: Guided settings with automatic quality control and failure explanations.

acceptance.tolerance: Mesh checks pass with max non-orthogonality < 65 degrees

statement: Configure parallel meshing and solving by decomposing the domain with scotch or simple methods.
superiority: Automatic core detection and load-balanced decomposition with scaling report.

acceptance.tolerance: Results identical across core counts within 1e-8; efficiency >= 70% to 8 cores

statement: Load a generated mesh into the host application to inspect it before solving.
superiority: Mesh viewer handles millions of cells interactively.

statement: Check mesh quality for skewness, orthogonality and aspect ratio and report whether it is valid to solve.
superiority: Inline quality report with offending cells highlighted and repair guidance.

acceptance.tolerance: All seeded defects found; counts equal reference checkMesh

statement: Select a steady incompressible flow recipe using a SIMPLE-type solver for pressure and velocity fields.
superiority: Robust steady solver with residual-based stopping and lossless restart.

acceptance.tolerance: Velocity profiles within 5% of published benchmark data

statement: Select a buoyant heat transfer recipe for natural convection and indoor thermal flows.
superiority: Coupled thermal-flow solver with energy balance residual report.

statement: Assemble a solution with controlDict, probes and write settings, then write the case and run it locally or in parallel.
superiority: One validated case builder with schema-checked parameters instead of free-text dictionary edits.

acceptance.tolerance: Case validates; run completes with expected residual drop

statement: Update any case parameter, including time-dependent changes, across the case folders before or during a run.
superiority: Parameter edits tracked with undo and a diff against the previous case.

acceptance.tolerance: Each edit applied once; undo restores case exactly

statement: Load results at the latest time step during a run and plot residuals to monitor convergence at a set interval.
superiority: Streaming results and residual plots without polling files.

acceptance.corpus: Run with 500 iterations and 4 residual fields
acceptance.tolerance: Plot updates within 2 s of each write; values equal logs

statement: Group room surfaces by boundary-condition type (inlet, outlet, wall, heat source) and combine them into an indoor CFD case.
superiority: Boundary-condition authoring with unit checks and a viewport legend.

acceptance.corpus: Room with supply diffuser and exhaust

statement: Run multiple wind directions in one virtual wind tunnel calculation and return per-direction wind fields.
superiority: Multi-direction batching on one mesh with shared case setup and GPU acceleration.

acceptance.tolerance: Per-direction results within 3% of independent runs; total time <= 50% of sequential

statement: Set up and run wind CFD cases on building geometry through a node-based interface with boundary-layer inlet conditions.
superiority: Atmospheric boundary-layer profile with roughness length and verified inlet conditions.

acceptance.corpus: ABL profile test with z0 = 0.03, 0.1, 0.5 m
acceptance.tolerance: Inlet velocity profile within 1% of log law

statement: Open results in an external visualisation tool such as ParaView and exchange case folders with the host app.
superiority: Standard VTK/OpenFOAM export and native viewer with section planes.

acceptance.tolerance: Exported fields equal in-app fields within 1e-9
